tagline: The PrusaSlicer 3D-printing slicer in your browser on a fast Selkies web desktop: slice and export G-code, no VNC client (amd64 + arm64).
description: PrusaSlicer, the FDM/SLA 3D-printing slicer from Prusa Research, on a Selkies web desktop. Slice in your browser: no VNC client, no local install. LinuxServer ship OrcaSlicer and Cura on Selkies but no PrusaSlicer; the only other browser images are years-old, abandoned noVNC builds. This is a maintained, modern Selkies (WebRTC) build for amd64 and arm64.
author: Junker der Provinz
title: PrusaSlicer
